biography.plain_text: Robert Krebs is a German beneficial owner associated with Hamburg’s Krebs Group, a family-run industrial-services business descended from a company established in 1949. The group works across corrosion protection, shipyard services, scaffolding and offshore support, combining several specialist companies serving maritime and industrial customers in Germany and other international markets today.
biography.html: Robert Krebs is a German beneficial owner associated with Hamburg’s Krebs Group, a family-run industrial-services business descended from a company established in 1949. The group works across corrosion protection, shipyard services, scaffolding and offshore support, combining several specialist companies serving maritime and industrial customers in Germany and other international markets today.

confidence.reason: The authoritative internal UBO record establishes Robert Krebs, while public vessel and Krebs Group sources support the company association, family ownership, Hamburg base and industrial activities without assigning a specific executive role.

long_biography.plain_text:
Family succession has shaped the Krebs enterprise through several generations. Founder Robert Krebs handed management to his son Walter in 1974; responsibility later passed to Detlef and Manfred Krebs as the business expanded beyond its original corrosion-protection operation.

The current group brings specialist companies together under private family control, with public management assigned to other Krebs family members and executives. Robert Krebs’s connection is represented through beneficial ownership rather than a published day-to-day title. The official company imprint names Detlef Krebs, Manfred Krebs and Christian Petschke as the representatives of Robert Krebs GmbH.
